name: co-deck
description: Presentation/deck production template — storyline, theme pipeline (HTML themes → PDF via pdf-lib), diagram and image curation, with visual-regression tests.

artifacts.description: Theme previews and built decks (build-theme-preview.ts writes docs/html-themes/preview/decks/; build-theme-deck.ts takes --output).

handoffs.trigger: HTML deck built; PDF export (slidedata.json → pdf-lib)

notes: Ships its own package.json: test = bun test scripts/co-deck/tests/ (theme suite), plus test:visual / test:visual:update / test:smoke. The common integration runner remains available via bun scripts/test-runner.ts.
